scope: native worker SIGTERM recovery and claimed starts that abort before container execution

behavior.shutdown: checkpoint journal and preserve native containers for API-verified restart adoption; no queued status or speculative terminal settlement
behavior.runner_cleanup: preserve mounts, encrypted volumes/workspaces and bookkeeping while the same authority is retained for shutdown handoff; normal cleanup otherwise
behavior.decommission: do not deregister a host with tracked containers or unsettled native attempts
behavior.tokenless_claim: persist no-execution abort, report failed with exact authority, then NACK; no container start or lease renewal
behavior.outage: retry settlement in process and directly from the recovery journal after restart; current replacement authority is preserved
behavior.other_unstarted_aborts: pre-start journal and command-result persistence failures share the settlement path
behavior.server_guard: existing API credential-mint miss still rolls back claim transaction

validation.postgres_api: real isolated PostgreSQL and FastAPI status/renew routes
validation.old_api_handoff: claim transaction is committed without callback token to simulate the older API response
validation.docker: isolated; no real GPU/container restart journey performed
validation.scratch_postgres: both final gates stopped their disposable clusters

remaining: canonical specs and remaining JSONB paths
canonical column and transitional trigger contraction
historical disposition and all-table semantic review
coordinated rollout and live GPU acceptance; repairs stay report_only
